purpose.zh: 稳定地给臀中肌加负荷，提升开腿力量和耐力
purpose.en: Load the side glutes steadily to build leg-opening strength and endurance.

text.zh: 坐稳靠背，膝外侧推开垫子
text.en: Sit back against the pad and push the pads out with your outer knees
Pause for one second at the top, then return over three seconds.

text.zh: 双手扶住把手，身体不前后晃
text.en: Hold the handles and keep your body from rocking.

commonErrors.en: Letting the weight slam back on the return.

cautions.zh: 髋部疼痛时减轻重量或减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Use less weight or less range if your hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
